resolvedArtChoices: Five distinct original scenes are provided; user requested people in the opening-time queue and white chapssaltteok.
The opening-hours placard is on the central display window, left of the door, for later safe lettering.
The shop display contains white chapssaltteok. A shallow kraft box holds three in scene 4; two remain with an empty liner after the woman takes one in scene 5.
Scene 3 shows several adult customers waiting toward the entrance, with the same muted-clothing queue continuing in scenes 4 and 5.
All dialogue, opening-hours text and brand/question copy remain separate from raw artwork.
